title: Lifestyle-induced regulatory T cell fragility primes adverse events after immune checkpoint blockade
title_zh: 生活方式诱导的调节性T细胞脆弱性预示免疫检查点抑制后不良事件
abstract: Immune checkpoint blockade has transformed cancer therapy, but immune-related adverse events (irAEs) remain a major, sometimes fatal, limitation, and the lack of robust preclinical models has hindered mechanistic insight. We present the lifestyle-induced susceptibility to irAEs (LISA) model, in which diet-driven metabolic and microbial alterations recreate human-like susceptibility to anti-PD-1 toxicity. LISA recapitulates multi-organ irAEs with immune infiltration and cytokine production, severity depending on sex, age, treatment modality, and immunotherapy response. Mechanistically, dysbiosis marked by Akkermansia muciniphila enrichment accompanies aberrant immune activation, driving regulatory T cell (Treg) fragility and CD8+ cytotoxic effector populations, both observed in patients with irColitis. Dietary reversal, metabolite supplementation, and blocking interferon (IFN)-γ production or signaling in Tregs restored Treg stability and resolved inflammation. Human-to-mouse fecal microbiome transfer interacts with recipient diet to shape susceptibility. Together, these findings identify dietary, microbial, and immune drivers of irAEs, which can be leveraged to improve immunotherapy responses while minimizing toxicity.
abstract_zh: 免疫检查点抑制已改变癌症治疗，但免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）仍是主要且有时致命的限制，缺乏可靠的临床前模型阻碍了机制研究。我们提出了生活方式诱导的irAEs易感性（LISA）模型，该模型通过饮食驱动的代谢和微生物改变重现了人类对抗PD-1毒性的易感性。LISA再现了多器官irAEs，伴随免疫细胞浸润和细胞因子产生，其严重程度取决于性别、年龄、治疗方式和免疫治疗反应。机制上，Akkermansia muciniphila 富集标志的菌群失调伴随异常免疫激活，导致调节性T细胞（Treg）脆弱和CD8+细胞毒性效应细胞群的扩增，这两者均在irColitis 患者中观察到。饮食逆转、代谢物补充以及阻断Treg中的干扰素（IFN-γ）产生或信号传导可恢复Treg稳定性并消除炎症。人源-鼠粪菌移植与受体饮食相互作用，塑造易感性。综上，这些发现识别了饮食、微生物和免疫因素对irAEs的驱动，可用于提升免疫治疗效果同时降低毒性。
